design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 of universal_life_account_service (Ashgrove universal life). Revision 2 (policy-task audit round 1 closed; revision log at the end).

[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,5,5]. Assignment: ul_ext_surrender_payout 6, ul_ext_surrender_charge_assessment 5, ul_ext_guideline_excess_refund 5.

[Why it is a good test] Denise asks only to complete the surrender she signed. The published rules hide two problems: the surrender value is paid only after the full-surrender charge stands booked, and it is not settled until premiums less refunds and withdrawals stand at or below the guideline premium limit. Her August 40000.00 check pushed premiums to 73375.00 against a 60000.00 limit, so the agent must refund the 13375.00 excess with earnings, book the graded, reduced surrender charge, and only then hand the surrender to her with a net figure that reconciles the account value carried to the effective date, the unearned deduction, the processing fee, a cost basis that leaves out the term conversion credit, 10 percent withholding and delayed-payment interest. Every figure comes from records: the request dates, the ledger, the term, whole life and CareAssure records.

[Scope] Task 0 occupied the overloan line (ul_ext_loan_interest_settlement, ul_ext_overloan_charge, ul_ext_overloan_protected_face; tools settle_loan_interest_b95e2dd6, assess_overloan_charge_72382565, exercise_overloan_protection_1091dc6b). Task 1 claims the surrender line: ul_ext_guideline_excess_refund (refund_guideline_excess_434d2811, agent), ul_ext_surrender_charge_assessment (assess_surrender_charge_840d0421, agent), ul_ext_surrender_payout (surrender_policy_65d610d4, user). No overlap; all six policies are covered by the two tasks.

[Problem-tree card] Root ul_ext_surrender_payout (owner's write). Edge A: payout -> surrender charge, value_input, gate po_charge_booked, form state, affirmative sentence "The surrender value is paid only after the full-surrender charge for the surrender request stands booked in the policy's activity history." - only the charge assessment books a full_surrender charge entry; seed: no charge entry, request approved. Edge B: payout -> guideline refund, value_input, gate po_refund_since, form state, negated sentence "The surrender value is not settled until the gross premiums received, less the premiums refunded and the partial withdrawals, stand at or below the guideline premium limit in the policy's activity history." - only the guideline excess refund lowers that figure; seed: 75400.00 - 2025.00 = 73375.00 > 60000.00. Four-point test: ordering connectives 'only after' / 'not until'; record-visible states; no tool, id or code token; scoped to the full-surrender charge and the guideline limit. The two edges are parallel and commute (actual run: charge 516.38, refund 13438.43 in the swapped order; identical terminal tables = True); gold order refund (step 10), charge (step 12), surrender (step 14). Deletion sensitivity: without the charge the net payment is 72173.57, without the refund 85154.69, against gold 71708.53. user_scenario mentions neither; tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Surrender subjects ul_policy_surrendered/ul_surrender_value_paid: ul_surrender gate signed_surrender_request - request f54a7083-42c3-4ee5-bee5-4741b8a834d8 type surrender, signed 2026-09-30, received 2026-10-01, approved; the only beneficiary line is revocable and no assignee is recorded, so no co-signature is needed; correlated through ul_request_id. Charge subject ul_surrender_charge_assessed: ul_surrender and ul_face_and_option_changes, no applicable gate. Refund subject ul_premium_refunded: ul_evt_premium_acceptance, no structured gate; the base 60-day window: received 2026-08-21, refund on 2026-10-08 is day 48, inside it. No time eligibility gate applies.

[Business-object card] Target policy UL30742219 (71e59d97-0480-487b-a999-94391f360186); surrender request f54a7083-42c3-4ee5-bee5-4741b8a834d8; excess payment 530f3a9e-5f55-4c35-bfde-dec81c629a98. Included: all 9 premium entries (gross 75400.00), the 2023 withdrawal (2025.00; non-taxable cash 2000.00), the latest deduction 2026-09-09 (96.40, COI 66.40), CareAssure benefit payments in six months (3). Excluded: CareAssure premium entries; the completed withdrawal request; the in-force whole life policy (exchange route needs a surrendered one); the stale cost_basis field 73375.00 (the rule figures basis from the ledger). Refund attaches to the excess payment; the charge and the surrender payment attach to the surrender request.

[Factor card] Refund: excess_earnings_rate 0.0375 (baseline 13388.35); late_refund_addition 0.01 (baseline 13425.07); earnings_start_date check +5 days (baseline 13447.16); earnings_end_date surrender effective date (baseline 13450.66); earnings_compounding monthly over thirty-day months (baseline no earnings 13375.00); whole baseline 13375.00 vs 13438.43. Charge: schedule_rate_grading 8.50 (baseline 607.50); issue_age_share_band 0.90 (baseline 573.75); surrender_funding_credit 0.10 (baseline 573.75); term_conversion_credit 0.25, cross-difficulty term (baseline 688.50); surrender_care_waiver 0.60, cross-difficulty ltc (baseline 1290.94); whole baseline 2500.00 vs 516.38. Payout: persistency_interest_bonus (baseline 71696.73); released_value_carry (baseline 71519.74); unearned_deduction_refund (baseline 71692.59); surrender_processing_fee (baseline 71758.56); surrender_cost_basis_source, cross-difficulty term (baseline 71888.53); delayed_payment_interest (baseline 71666.43); whole baseline 71691.83 vs 71708.53. Multi-source: excess_earnings_rate (allocation AND days), term_conversion_credit (conversion link AND term years), surrender_care_waiver (claim status AND payment count), surrender_cost_basis_source. Near-misses: CareAssure premium entries; whole life in force not surrendered; the request's signed date versus received date. Overrides declared: base surrender charge, cash surrender value, taxable amount and guideline refund sentences.

[World rows] customers; term_holdings (converted Level Term 20); whole_holdings (in-force final expense); ul_holdings; ul_transactions (conversion credit, 7 annual premiums, August check, beneficiary line, 2023 withdrawal, three months of deductions and interest); ul_service_requests (approved surrender, completed withdrawal); ltc_holdings (claim_active) and ltc_transactions (3 benefit payments, 2 premium payments). Automatic clauses checked: next monthly anniversary 2026-10-09 is after the frozen date; no grace; the 60-day refund window still open; the policy year changes on 2027-03-09.

[Persona] Denise, 61, brisk after a stroke; volunteers only the surrender request; identity given when asked; payout method and withholding given when asked; history (conversion, whole life, CareAssure claim, the August check) only when asked; passive acceptance of the refund and the charge; completes the surrender with the date and amount given; ends when told it is complete.

[Standard solution] Locate, verify (1965-01-22, 6274, 15143), read policy, requests, activity, term, whole life, CareAssure policy and activity; refund 13438.43 against the August check; book surrender charge 516.38; hand over the surrender, Denise confirms effective date 2026-10-01 and 71708.53.

[Verification run] Authoring code replays gold with the real tools and evaluates each compute on the handling-time world with check_compute's evaluator: refund 13438.43, charge 516.38, net payment 71708.53; factor and edge sensitivities as above.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Rules: the surrender needs an approved signed request (found); the surrender value waits on a booked full-surrender charge (none) and on premiums within the guideline limit (73375.00 > 60000.00) - so refund and charge first, in either order, then the surrender. All figures follow from the visible reads; matches gold.

[Revision log - audit round 1]
- F-2 (rule/compute on compounding months): the refund rule now says 'compounded monthly over the whole thirty-day months in that period', matching compute (earnings_days // 30 and % 30); the 36-day period 2026-08-26 .. 2026-10-01 is one thirty-day month plus 6 days under the published text, so the refund 13438.43 and the net payment are the single reading.
- F-7 (dishonest factor baseline): earnings_compounding's baseline is now 'no earnings' (0), its fall-through tier and what the computation document states; recorded factor_sensitivity for it is 13375.00 (was 13437.66). Scored values unchanged.
- O-3: the payout policy now lists ul_evt_policy_loan in base_policy_refs and declares in overwrite that its loan-interest sentence replaces the base loan-rate sentence (no value change: no loan on this policy).
- Seed observation: the CareAssure holding's monthly_max_benefit is 5066.62 (4000.00 grown 3 percent compound over eight anniversaries since 2018), so the 4120.00 benefit payments sit within it.
user_scenario:
You are Denise Kowalczyk-Amari, sixty-one, a former school librarian from Sewickley. Since a stroke in May you tire easily and speak in short, practical sentences; your husband is out, so you are handling this call yourself, and you want it finished today.

You own an Ashgrove universal life policy on your own life. You mailed a signed form to surrender it on September 30, and you want the policy cashed in now and the money paid to you, because you need the cash to make your house safe for your recovery, a stair lift and a walk-in shower. You know surrendering ends the coverage and you are sure about it. You open by saying you sent in the signed papers to cash in your universal life policy and you want it completed and the money deposited. Doing it is your own decision, and you will confirm it yourself if they need you to.

To be found, you give your name and your phone number, 4125550168. When the representative asks you to verify your identity, you give, one at a time as asked, your date of birth, January 22, 1965 (1965-01-22), the last four of your Social Security number, 6274, and your ZIP code, 15143. If asked for the policy number you read it off the annual statement: UL30742219. If asked how the money should be paid, you say by direct deposit to the bank account Ashgrove already has, the same one you used on the form. If asked about tax withholding, you say you checked the box on the form for the standard federal withholding.

Only if the representative asks about other coverage with Ashgrove, you mention that this policy started as an Ashgrove twenty-year term policy you took out in 2016 and converted in 2020, that you still have a small Ashgrove final expense whole life policy, and that your Ashgrove CareAssure long-term care policy has been paying for your home care since the summer. Only if the representative asks about recent payments, you say you mailed in a large check in August from your late aunt's estate because you had meant to keep building the policy, before your plans changed. You do not remember the exact balances or how the charges are worked out, and you say so if asked.

You do not tell the representative how to do their job. If the representative says that part of a payment has to be sent back to you first, you say that is fine and to send it back the usual way. If the representative tells you there is a surrender charge and gives you the amount, you say you understand and to go ahead. When the representative hands you the final step to complete yourself, you carry it out exactly as they describe it, using the effective date and the net amount they tell you, and you read back what the system shows if they ask.

If a figure the representative gives does not match what you vaguely expected, you only say you cannot check it yourself and you will go by Ashgrove's records. Once the representative tells you the surrender is complete and the money is on its way to your bank, you thank them and say goodbye.

edges.condition: ul_transactions carries an ul_surrender_charge_assessed entry with charge_reason full_surrender on the approved surrender request.
edges.policy_source: The surrender value is paid only after the full-surrender charge for the surrender request stands booked in the policy's activity history.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The activity history holds no surrender charge entry for the approved surrender request.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 12 books a full_surrender charge entry of 516.38 on f54a7083-42c3-4ee5-bee5-4741b8a834d8; po_charge_booked becomes 516.38.

edges.condition: In ul_transactions the gross premiums received less the ul_premium_refunded amounts and the ul_partial_withdrawal amounts are at or below the greater of the guideline single premium and the guideline level premium times the policy years begun.
edges.policy_source: The surrender value is not settled until the gross premiums received, less the premiums refunded and the partial withdrawals, stand at or below the guideline premium limit in the policy's activity history.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and independent: the surrender charge reads the surrender request, the schedule, the gross premiums (not refunds), the term and CareAssure records; the refund reads premiums, refunds, withdrawals and the surrender request date (not surrender charges). Actual run with the charge booked before the refund: charge 516.38, refund 13438.43, terminal state identical to the gold order (canonical table comparison = True). The payout comes after both.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the charge the net payment recomputes to 72173.57 instead of 71708.53, and the terminal ledger lacks the 516.38 charge entry.
Without the refund the net payment recomputes to 85154.69 instead of 71708.53 (the excess stays in the value released and in the cost basis), and the terminal ledger lacks the 13438.43 refund entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only completing the signed surrender and paying the money. It never mentions a refund, an excess, a guideline limit or a surrender charge before the agent does; the August check is disclosed only if the agent asks about recent payments, and the refund and the charge appear only as passive reactions ('If the representative says that part of a payment has to be sent back to you first...', 'If the representative tells you there is a surrender charge...'). No policy id appears in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: task_tools.py: surrender_policy_65d610d4 only updates ul_holdings and ul_service_requests and creates the payment entry; refund_guideline_excess_434d2811 and assess_surrender_charge_840d0421 only create one entry each; none reads the ledger, the limit or another entry, none returns an error, so the surrender can be written while the refund or the charge is missing.
